name: Name In Vain
overview: Scripture firmly commands believers not to take the name of the LORD in vain, warning that God will hold accountable anyone who does so, as emphasized in both Exodus 20:7 and Deuteronomy 5:11. This prohibition extends to swearing falsely by God's name or profaning it, highlighting the sacredness of His name (Leviticus 19:12). The seriousness of this offense is further underscored by God's promise to protect His holy name from pollution among His people, making it known as holy to both Israel and the nations (Ezekiel 39:7). Jesus' teaching in Matthew 5:33 reinforces the call to integrity in oaths made before the Lord, underscoring the reverence due to God's name in all speech.
